definitions.explanation: A scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

examples.japanese: {化学|かがく}の{実験|じっけん}をした。
{実験|じっけん}{結果|けっか}をレポートにまとめた。
examples.english: I compiled the experimental results into a report.

examples.japanese: {動物|どうぶつ}{実験|じっけん}に{反対|はんたい}する{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The number of people opposed to animal testing is increasing.

notes:
{実験|じっけん}する is used as a する-verb meaning "to experiment."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実験|じっけん}する (to experiment)
- {実験|じっけん}{室|しつ} (laboratory)
- {実験|じっけん}{結果|けっか} (experimental results)
- {実験|じっけん}{台|だい} (experimental subject, test bench)
- {実験|じっけん}{動物|どうぶつ} (laboratory animal)
- {実験|じっけん}{的|てき} (experimental)

COMPARISON:
- {実験|じっけん}: experiment (scientific testing)
- {研究|けんきゅう}: research (broader investigation)
